# Unit test executable: links the library of the main program plus the
# doctest test files below. The tests compare the C++ code against reference
# values generated by the Python implementation (reference/, see
# reference/generate_reference.py and reference/run_python_reference.py).
#
# Test cases in the doctest suite "integration" run full Monte Carlo
# integrations and take a minute or so; the rest take about a second. ctest
# runs them as two separate tests, so `ctest -R unit` gives the fast ones.

set(TEST_SOURCES
    test_main.cpp
    test_rcbk_table.cpp
    test_interpolation.cpp
    test_dipole.cpp
    test_wavefunctions.cpp
    test_quadrupole.cpp
    test_integrands.cpp
    test_integration.cpp
    test_sampling.cpp
    test_cross_sections.cpp
    )

add_executable(dis_tests ${TEST_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(dis_tests PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party)
target_link_libraries(dis_tests PRIVATE dis_lib)
target_compile_definitions(dis_tests PRIVATE
    DIS_REFERENCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/reference"
    DIS_BKFILE="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../data/mv.dat")

add_test(NAME unit COMMAND dis_tests --test-suite-exclude=integration)
add_test(NAME integration COMMAND dis_tests --test-suite=integration)
